comments.body: A licensed clause can still contain rejected alternatives: `read_discourse` filters those alternatives when deciding the clause status but retains them in `analyses`. Selecting element zero here can therefore build the query from a rejected reading instead of the licensed question. For example, placing a rejected `args=[None]` reading before the licensed `args=['hind']` reading produces `UNKNOWN`; reversing the same alternatives produces `SUPPORTED`. Filter for non-rejected, syntax-licensed, reference-complete analyses before checking the claim count and selecting the query.

scope: External review hypothesis; independently reproduced before implementation change.
